label: Finding-11
title: no-exploitation: Time of the Austin interview is wrong: the post is 08:00 UTC (09:00 BST), not 08:00 BST
description: claims.json 'by' says '08:00 BST 22 October'; exploitation.json and timeline.json date it 2026-10-22T07:00Z. The capture's page.html JSON-LD gives the post datePublished 2026-10-22T08:00:23.293Z, and the rendered page (UTC browser) shows 'published at 08:00'. The vault's BBC notes.md is the origin of the BST error (the 07:55Z curl copy showed BST clock times, the Playwright capture shows UTC).
